product.name: Monoprice Keystone Jack HDMI Female to Female Coupler Adapter White
product.description: Include an HDMI® connection in your custom audio-video wall plate using this HDMI Coupler Keystone Jack from Monoprice!This keystone jack is designed to fit any standard keystone wall plate. It features a gold-plated female connector on each end, allowing you run a CL2/In-wall rated HDMI cable through the wall.This keystone has no effect on the signal and therefore supports all High Speed HDMI features, including 3D video, 4K video, and high-definition multichannel compressed audio.Support Files: Dimensions Diagram (Apr 18, 2013)HDMI®, the HDMI Logo, and High-Definition Multimedia Interface are trademarks or registered trademarks of HDMI Licensing LLC in the United States and other countries.  Warning: This product may contain a chemical known to the State of California to cause cancer, birth defects, or other reproductive harm.
